text:
Carmen: Vortex asked for a 1-day POC focusing on mixed workloads. They want steady chat throughput, embeddings spikes, and explicit cold-start behavior. Also will want a short cost comparison and answers for GDPR/dataroom items. Can we sketch a run and a short results template?
Ibrahim: Copy. Do we have target qps split and models?
Carmen: Aim for 400 qps steady total: 70% chat (7B chat, ~500 token avg response), 30% embeddings (2B embed, avg 1k tokens input for embedding mix). Bursts: embeddings-heavy spikes to 1.5k qps for 10s. Region: eu-west primary but want multi-az failover.
June: Proposed run plan:
- 20m ramp to 400 qps (route requests 70/30 chat/embed)
- 45m steady at 400 qps (collect p50/p95/p99 per workload, GPU util, KV cache hit, embedding batch sizes)
- 4 embedding bursts: 1500 qps for 10s spaced 12m apart
- Cold-start test: stop one pool and send 50 cold connections at t+5m, measure first-response latency distribution
- Cooldown 15m
Ibrahim: Ops snippet for loadgen to paste in deck:

```
# loadgen
--total-qps 400
--mix "chat:70,embed:30"
--ramp 1200s
--steady 2700s
--burst "embed:1500:10s x4"
--cold-start-test "50:30s"
--samples ./vortex-samples.json
--metrics http://prometheus:9090/metrics
```

Rae: Security questions they flagged: GDPR/data residency, DLP/exfil protection, SOC2, private peering, and a dataroom for security docs. I'll assemble the pack. On-prem path for air-gapped installs is standard 6-8w.
June: Quick staging numbers (dedicated A100-equivalent, mixed pool warmed): chat fp16 steady 280 qps (p95=160ms, p99=340ms); embeddings batching steady 140 qps (p95=45ms, p99=120ms) with batch size ~64. End-to-end mixed pipeline achieved 420 total qps with p95 aggregated ~180ms, p99~360ms.
Ibrahim: Embedding bursts caused queueing; without soft-eviction p99 peaked ~900ms. Enabling prefix KV cache for chat and soft-eviction reduced chat p99 by ~28% during embedding spikes.
June: Quantized chat (4-bit) increases throughput ~1.9x but p99 worsens ~1.4x in bursty mixed runs. For embeddings quant doesn't apply.
CostBot: Ballpark hosted example: $0.46 / 1k tokens for model calls -> chat per req ~0.23 (for 500 tokens); embeddings priced per 1k tokens differently, example $0.12 / 1k tokens -> per embed ~0.12. Present both per-request and per-hour/day examples. Dedicated reserved estimate: to sustain 400 qps mixed with headroom ~ $1.6k/day amortized. Multi-AZ active-active +30% infra.
Rae: Draft recommendations: Dedicated reserved for tight p99 SLAs; enable prefix KV cache for chat, use large embed batch sizes to reduce cost, and prewarm pools 30m before go-live. For cost-sensitive customers, offer quantized chat option with clear tail-risk callout.
Carmen: Nice. Can someone assemble a one-page run summary + short sec pack? I want to send POC charter by EOD Tue.
Ibrahim: I'll put a short run report template with graphs placeholders (qps over time, p95/p99 per workload, CPU/GPU util, cache hit).
June: Note for the deck: cold-starts show median cold response ~1.2s on our staging; recommend prewarmed pools if they need sub-500ms cold starts.
Rae: I'll compile GDPR and dataroom items and share the doc link.
Carmen: Let's rehearse Tue 09:00 CET.
